title: Ben at the Hotel
setting: The lobby of a big hotel with a front desk and a guest computer.

characters.name: Ben
characters.look: Ben (a ten-year-old boy with curly red hair, freckles, a green T-shirt and blue shorts)

characters.name: Dan
characters.look: Dan (a tall man of about forty with a short brown beard and a navy jumper)

sentences.en: Ben and Dad arrive at a big hotel.
sentences.zh: 本和爸爸到了一家大酒店。
sentences.scene_prompt: Ben (a ten-year-old boy with curly red hair, freckles, a green T-shirt and blue shorts) and his dad Dan (a tall man of about forty with a short brown beard and a navy jumper) walk into a big hotel lobby pulling suitcases.

sentences.en: Ben's phone has no internet here.
sentences.zh: 本的手机在这里上不了网。
sentences.scene_prompt: Ben (a ten-year-old boy with curly red hair, freckles, a green T-shirt and blue shorts) frowns at his phone in the hotel lobby, the phone screen grey and empty.
sentences.draw_note: Shows Ben frowning at a blank phone; 'no internet' is only hinted.

sentences.en: He is lucky: the hotel has a computer.
sentences.zh: 他运气不错：酒店有一台电脑。
sentences.scene_prompt: Ben (a ten-year-old boy with curly red hair, freckles, a green T-shirt and blue shorts) smiles and points at a computer on a desk in the lobby.

sentences.en: He sends Mia an email about the hotel website.
sentences.zh: 他给米娅发了一封电子邮件，介绍酒店的网站。
sentences.scene_prompt: Ben (a ten-year-old boy with curly red hair, freckles, a green T-shirt and blue shorts) types at the lobby computer, the screen showing a web page with a photo of the hotel.
sentences.draw_note: Shows Ben at the computer with a hotel web page; who receives the email can't be shown.

sentences.en: Then he takes photos with his new camera.
sentences.scene_prompt: Ben (a ten-year-old boy with curly red hair, freckles, a green T-shirt and blue shorts) takes a photo of the grand lobby with a small new camera.

sentences.en: Soon Mia sends him a happy message.
sentences.zh: 很快，米娅给他回了一条开心的消息。
sentences.scene_prompt: The lobby computer screen shows a big yellow smiley face; Ben (a ten-year-old boy with curly red hair, freckles, a green T-shirt and blue shorts) grins at it.
sentences.draw_note: Shows a smiley face on the screen and Ben grinning; the sender and 'soon' can't be shown.

sentences.en: Dad uses the desk telephone to call home.
sentences.zh: 爸爸用前台的电话给家里打电话。
sentences.scene_prompt: Dan (a tall man of about forty with a short brown beard and a navy jumper) talks on an old telephone at the hotel front desk.

sentences.en: Next, Dad gets a hot drink from a machine.
sentences.zh: 接着，爸爸从机器里买了一杯热饮。
sentences.scene_prompt: Dan (a tall man of about forty with a short brown beard and a navy jumper) takes a cup of hot coffee from a drinks machine while Ben (a ten-year-old boy with curly red hair, freckles, a green T-shirt and blue shorts) watches.
